title: release.yml publishes only a v* tag whose commit is reachable from main: a guard job gates every publishing job and every build checks out the verified commit

criteria.then: it has a credential-free guard job that resolves the tag to a commit, requires it to match the pushed commit on a tag push, and requires it to be an ancestor of origin/main
it depends (directly or transitively) on the guard job, so a failed guard stops all publishing on both the tag push and the workflow_dispatch path

criteria.given: the jobs that build or publish (jar, deploy-packages, docker, npm-embed-build)
criteria.then: each checks out the commit the guard verified rather than whatever branch the dispatcher picked
